answer: Resist sybils with scarce seed tickets. Each epoch a VRF names a summit of long-trusted validators; each releases only a walnut-hard handful of single-use admission tickets that wander a few hops on the vouch graph. Seats must collect tickets from several unrelated seeds before rewards unlock. A nebula of clones can densify its own cluster, but it cannot mint tickets or reach honest seeds without costly real edges, so most clones stay ticketless and earn nothing.
